data.name: Black Pyramid
data.detailed_description:
Game Overview

The Black Pyramid

The Black Pyramid is an interactive cinematic game whose vast majority of visual assets are AI-generated. For years, Ethan has been trapped within his own body, cursed by an ancient hex that spawned a scarab beetle parasitic near his heart, steadily draining his life force. This malevolent creature devours his vitality day by day and unleashes catastrophic misfortune upon everything he touches. Crushed by despair and the relentless march of time, his only chance to break free lies buried beneath the sweltering Egyptian desert: the legendary, forbidden Black Pyramid.

The Adventure

Embark on a heart-stopping quest for redemption in this story-driven adventure game, where you assume the role of Ethan. He cannot endure this ordeal alone. A mysterious woman named Layla joins his journey; her profound mastery of ancient Egyptian occultism runs as deep as the secrets she conceals. Together, you must overcome deadly traps, unravel age-old riddles, and confront the malevolent entities guarding the pyramid’s innermost depths. Can you trust her? Or does she harbor ulterior motives?

Game Features

  • Race Against Time: Countdown timers are integrated into numerous interactive segments. You must act within the time limit, and different choices made under pressure will unlock branching narrative paths.

  • Dynamic Story Branches: No two playthroughs are identical. Your decisions unveil distinct secrets and lead to vastly different endings and fates.

  • Immersive World Design: Explore the eerie, haunting beauty of the Black Pyramid. Rich lore, atmospheric sound design, and breathtaking visuals bring this ancient tomb vividly to life.

  • Complex Companion Dynamics: Forge a deep bond with Layla… or perhaps with other figures along the way.

Break the curse. Escape the pyramid alive. Forge your own legend.
